sn46.54:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati haliddavasanannāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
sn46.54:1.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya haliddavasanaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃsu.
sn46.54:1.4: atippago kho tāva haliddavasanaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
sn46.54:1.5: yannūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmāti.
sn46.54:2.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn46.54:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ.
sn46.54:3.1: samaṇo āvuso gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
sn46.54:3.2: etha tumhe bhikkhave pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha tathā dutiyaṃ. tathā tatiyaṃ. tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharatha.
sn46.54:3.3: karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha tathā dutiyaṃ. tathā tatiyaṃ. tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ karuṇāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharatha.
sn46.54:3.4: muditāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha tathā dutiyaṃ. tathā tatiyaṃ. tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ muditāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharatha.
sn46.54:3.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha tathā dutiyaṃ. tathā tatiyaṃ. tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharathāti.
sn46.54:4.1: mayampi kho āvuso sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema
sn46.54:4.2: etha tumhe āvuso pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha …pe…
sn46.54:4.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha tathā dutiyaṃ. tathā tatiyaṃ. tathā catutthaṃ.
sn46.54:4.6: iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharathāti.
sn46.54:4.7: idha no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyaso kinnānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsananti.
sn46.54:5.1: atha kho te bhikkhū tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃsu nappaṭikkosiṃsu
sn46.54:5.3: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmāti.
sn46.54:5.4: atha kho te bhikkhū haliddavasane piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ.
sn46.54:6.1: idha mayaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya haliddavasanaṃ piṇḍāya pavisimha.
sn46.54:6.3: atippago kho tāva haliddavasanaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
sn46.54:7.1: yannūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyāmāti. atha kho mayaṃ bhante yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamimha upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodimha
sn46.54:7.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdimha. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho amhe bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ.

sn46.54:10.1: atha kho mayaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandimha nappaṭikkosimha anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamimha

sn46.54:11.1: evaṃvādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā
sn46.54:11.2: kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso mettā cetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā.
sn46.54:11.3: kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso karuṇā cetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā.
sn46.54:11.4: kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso muditā cetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā.
sn46.54:11.5: kathaṃ bhāvitā panāvuso upekkhā cetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānāti.
sn46.54:11.6: evaṃ puṭṭhā bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti.
sn46.54:11.9: nāhantaṃ bhikkhave passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
sn46.54:12.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave mettā cetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā.
sn46.54:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu mettāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti …pe…
sn46.54:12.3: mettāsahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.54:12.4: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati
sn46.54:12.5: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati
sn46.54:12.6: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati
sn46.54:12.7: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati
sn46.54:12.8: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūlañca paṭikūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno subhaṃ vā kho pana vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn46.54:12.9: subhaparamāhaṃ bhikkhave mettācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi. idha paññassa bhikkhuno uttarivimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.
sn46.54:13.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave karuṇā cetovimutti kiṃgatikā hoti kimparamā kimphalā kimpariyosānā.
sn46.54:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu karuṇāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti …pe…
sn46.54:13.3: karuṇāsahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.54:13.4: so sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati …pe…
sn46.54:13.5: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūlañca paṭikūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno
sn46.54:13.6: sabbaso vā pana rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
